div.div:
CVA6 path (CoreType = CORE_CVA6):
- replaces RV32 core_region + OBI buffers + OBI->AXI bridges with corejack_cva6_axi_adapter
- core_axi_req[0] = cva6 native AXI; core_axi_req[1] is tied to '0; SBA path (core_axi_req[2]) is unchanged
- sim + FPGA + debug supported (cfg/cores/cva6.yaml)

div.div:
Legend:
blue = bus/fabric
green = CPU / core region
purple = memory
orange = debug
yellow = peripherals (UART)
red = reset
white = pin / external

div.div:
Not yet drawn on this page (RTL is authoritative):
- The iDMA data path is NOT an xbar initiator. soc_idma reaches soc_mem_ss ports 3/4 through its own soc_axi_to_mem instance; only its CSR leg (xbar -> soc_axi_to_apb) uses the fabric. See the AXI Fabric page.
- The CVA6 leg passes through an axi_isolate stage on rst_ni, so a core-only reset cannot orphan a transaction the fabric accepted.
- soc_axi_to_mem is instantiated twice (xbar leg and iDMA leg) and is pipelined (MaxOutstanding).
